methodology.value_formula: research_quality = 0.5 × GPQA Diamond + 0.5 × Humanity’s Last Exam (without tools); value = research_quality / user workload cost. The displayed 0–100 score is normalized only among models with both results.
methodology.caveat: Only same-named, publicly reported evaluations are combined. Every score may carry its own source and run conditions. MMLU-Pro is not MMMU-Pro. Coding tests are ranked separately because LiveCodeBench, SWE-Bench Pro, Terminal-Bench and FrontierSWE use different task sets and/or harnesses. Missing data is not estimated.
